title: Availability that follows the season
content:
Recurring events now recompute every occurrence against the zone rather than the offset, which means a weekly call booked in March stays at the same local hour on both ends when daylight saving moves.

  • Recurring occurrences store a zone, not an offset
  • A warning appears when a series crosses a transition
  • Existing series are migrated on first edit

title: Calendar overlay for bookers
content: Anyone opening your booking page can now connect their own calendar and see it laid over your free times. Nothing is stored, nothing is shared with you — the overlay is drawn in their browser and forgotten when they close the tab.

title: Routing forms
content:
Ask up to five questions before a booking, and send the answer to whichever calendar should have it. A question can branch, and a branch can end in a different event type with different availability.

  • Short answer, choice and yes-or-no questions
  • Branch on any answer
  • Answers arrive in the calendar invite

title: Payments hold the slot
content: When an event type has a price, the slot is held for fifteen minutes while the payment completes, instead of being released the moment the visitor leaves the page. Failed payments release it immediately.

title: Teams, pooled properly
content:
Round-robin now balances by how many meetings each person has actually taken this month, not by whose turn it is in a list. Collective availability finds the hour that everyone shares, including people whose working hours differ.

  • Fairness-weighted round-robin
  • Collective availability across mixed working hours
  • Shared event types with one owner

title: Embeds without an iframe scrollbar
content: The embed now reports its own height to the host page, so the booking page grows and shrinks in place instead of sitting inside a box with its own scrollbar. One line of markup, unchanged.
